metadata.title: A history & bibliography of the Giunti (Junta) printing family in Spain 1526 - 1628 : this work covers the Junta (Giunti) Press and the Imprenta Real in Burgos, Salamanca & Madrid ; with a brief history of the several Giunti presses in Venice, Florence and Lyon and a bibliography of the Press of Juan Bautista Varesio in Burgos, Valladolid & Lerma
